config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chat]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "prov-chat-secret"

[[models]]
name = "rd-old"
provider = "chat"
model = "gpt-4o"
dialect = "openai-chat"
aliases = ["rd-old-alias"]
enabled = false
name: m4_route_dialect_disabled_reserved
